user.title: LUMA Outages
user.description: Pick the LUMA regions to follow. LUMA reports outages per region, not per city: San Juan, Bayamón, Caguas, Carolina, Arecibo, Mayagüez and Ponce. Home Assistant will make one test request when you submit.

data.include_island_total: Also add a Puerto Rico total
data.significant_outage_percent: Significant outage threshold (% of customers without service)

data_description.custom_headers: LUMA only answers requests that look like a phone or the Mi LUMA site. A mobile User-Agent is sent by default. If you get a 'blocked' error, paste headers copied from your browser's developer tools, e.g. {"User-Agent": "...", "Origin": "https://miluma.lumapr.com"}.

error.invalid_headers: Custom headers must be a JSON object with text values.
error.blocked: LUMA rejected the request. Add device-emulation headers (see the field help) and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach LUMA. Try again in a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: LUMA Outages is already set up. Use Configure to change regions.
